items.name: Business website
items.description: design, build, SEO basics, contact form

policies.ownership: You own the code and accounts after final payment.
policies.support: Two weeks of free bug fixes; new features are quoted separately.
policies.timeline: Timelines start after the advance and after content is received.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: Most business sites land between 60,000 and 180,000 PKR depending on pages and features.
10–21 days for a business site, longer for stores and apps.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to start?
faqs.a: Your logo, content and a reference site you like — then we begin.

tone.style: confident and human, no sales voice

goals.primary: get to a scoped quote or a call
goals.target: quote sent with scope and timeline

escalation.when: legal/contract questions, or a project above 500,000 PKR
